basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and education enthusiast from the West Coast, USA. I spend my days working as a high school guidance counselor, helping students navigate the college application process. In my free time, I enjoy playing VALORANT and trading on Roblox, and I'm a huge fan of podcasts like Spittin' Chiclets. I’m single, and my online hours are typically late evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Education and work experience in academic counseling, which gives me a solid understanding of the college application process and standardized testing. My love for gaming and trading is self-taught through years of participation in online communities.
